metadata.name: Belgian Collector Trial Pre-Impact Sediment Core Analysis
metadata.description: This dataset contains sediment core analysis from the Belgian collector trial pre-impact, including measurements of various elements (Al, Ba, Ca2+, Cr, Cu, Fe, K+, La, Li, Mg2+, Mn, Na+, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) and their relative errors. The data is collected from a single station (SO268_074MUC) with coordinates at 14.13508333 N, -125.86365 W, and an elevation of -4518.1 meters. The measurements are taken at different depths within the sediment core, with the date and time of the event recorded as 2019-03-20 02:30:12.
